references.text: Parallel text describing the actual execution of the instruction regarding the twenty boards for the south side of the tabernacle.
Preceding verses describing the instructions for the boards and their sockets, providing context for verse 18.
Continuation of the instructions concerning the boards, including the silver sockets beneath them.
God's command to build a sanctuary (mishkan) where He may dwell among His people, stating the overarching purpose of the tabernacle's construction.
Describes the camp of the sons of Kohath on the south side of the tabernacle, illustrating the continued significance of the south side's placement.
The fulfillment of the instruction for the north side demonstrates the symmetrical unity in the tabernacle's construction.
Describes the construction detail that enables the twenty boards on the south side to function as a unified wall.
